run: plan item 4.2: the shell catalogue's split of a joined shell on synthetic known answers (4 + 2 on three grids, 2 + 2 + 2, the reverse direction, unjoined and unsplit shells, the cut's bias, 300 synthetic configurations for the sampling error), the Demo and the dev cases; the model-visible snapshots; arms A and A+ on the dev set before (c4d8d83) and after (e9e67e1), 2026-10-19
evidence: Plan item 4.2 (docs/AGENT_PLAN.md, phase 4): for a first shell joined across a deep trough, find_gr_peaks returned the peaks in the shell, the first peak alone's window and CN and the summed count, and its note quoted the peaks' separation, so a model quoting a Jahn-Teller split subtracted two g(r) peak positions by hand (the review found it), a number provenance flags as unsourced and no reference can carry; nor are the maxima of g the bonds' means (dev-jahn-teller: 0.31 A apart for a planted 0.32). Known answers after the change (src/llm/__tests__/shells.test.js): 4 x 1.93 + 2 x 2.25 A at sigma 0.05 A on 0.005, 0.01 and 0.02 A grids reads 4 + 2 (shares 2/3 and 1/3 within 0.005, the parts summing to the shell's CN to 1e-12), each mean and long - short (0.32 A) within 0.002 A, a tolerance from the grid and the widths: the means are moments of r2g, so the quadrature moves them by < 1e-4 A at h/sigma <= 0.4, and the tails cut at the inter-peak minimum and below the onset lie 3 sigma out (~0.1 % of a part, < 5e-4 A on a mean); 2 + 2 + 2 at 1.95, 2.12 and 2.32 A (sigma 0.03 A) reads three thirds and 0.37 A; 1 + 0.5 F per Cu with Cu four times as dense is joined by the reverse count and said as 4 + 2 Cu per F; a one-peak shell, a 3 + 3 shell whose peaks overlap without a deep trough and a shell without densities have no split. The cut's bias: as the parts overlap, long - short reads high, by 0.001-0.0017 A at sigma 0.07 A and by 0.006 A (2 %) at sigma 0.085 A, the join's edge (the trough at 20 % of the first peak). The sampling error (each part's spread over the square root of its bonds in the box, the bonds independent): over 300 synthetic configurations of 216 octahedra at sigma 0.05 A, histogrammed as the dev cases' partials are, (long - short - 0.32)/error has mean 0.06, sd 0.96 and 95 % coverage 0.953; at sigma 0.07 A the cut's bias is about half an error at 216 octahedra (coverage 0.93) and three quarters at 1,000 (0.87), and a noise maximum on a flank, a resolved peak to the peak finder, adds a part in 9 of 400 configurations of 216 octahedra (none of 400 at 1,000, or at sigma 0.05 A), as it moves the first peak alone. Three or more parts: in the E-e Jahn-Teller problem an octahedron's distortion is 4 + 2 (a Q3 elongation), 2 + 4 (a compression) or, between them, short, medium and long pairs (2 + 2 + 2); long - short, the longest part's mean minus the shortest's, lies between rho sqrt(3)/2 and rho, the amplitude, whatever the mix, and the shares show the mix, where short against the rest would read 2 + 2 + 2 as a 2 + 4 compression. Only joined shells: where the peaks overlap without a deep trough the minimum cuts through both bond groups (the Demo's Ta-Se: 3.25 + 2.75 for 3 + 3) and a resolved peak can hide a group in its flank (dev-offcentre's Nb-O: 0.89 + 5.11 for 1 + 4 + 1). On the Demo and the dev cases: the Demo joins no shell; dev-jahn-teller's Cu-F reads 3.98 F per Cu at 1.929 A + 2.01 at 2.251 A, long - short 0.321 +- 0.0043 A; the one other joined shell of the dev set, the judgment subset's octahedral clusters (a cluster_distortion case, where a jahn_teller claim is tolerated), has a split too (find_gr_peaks shows it as the catalogue reads it: shellReading.test.js; its values are not written here). Arms A and A+ on dev before (c4d8d83) and after (e9e67e1): one of 45 records moves, dev-jahn-teller__A+, whose claim reads 0.321 A where it read the maxima's 0.31, with a find_gr_peaks reading of the split added and the score 0.9167 unchanged (the magnitude was and is within tolerance; the long axis has no app rule and stays unnamed); re-recorded in validation/baseline/arm-a-dev.json at e9e67e1. What the model sees: the three tool-list snapshots (+123 characters each, the description), the 32k budget pins +48 tokens (the dock) and +49 (arm B); every tool-result snapshot is unchanged, since the Demo joins no shell; the scripted runs' record files (validation/__tests__/__snapshots__/records/) move only in each request's length and hash (+121 characters a request with tools) and, in harness.coordination-square, its find_gr_peaks step on dev-jahn-teller's Cu-F shell (the split and the new note). The test set was not run. Approved by the manager on the user's delegation, 2026-10-19.
proposed_fix: src/llm/context/shells.js gives every joined shell a split (splitOf over readShell's splitEdges): the parts cut at the minimum of the smoothed g between each two successive resolved peaks (the first cut is the first peak alone's), the last ending at the shell's boundary, each { window, cn, reverseCn, share, meanR, sdR } with its CN over exactly its window; longMinusShort (the last part's mean minus the first's), longMinusShortSe (the configuration's sampling error, the bonds independent; not the fit's uncertainty) and direction (the count the join decided by). find_gr_peaks returns it as first_shell.split ({ parts: [{ window_A, mean_d_A, sd_d_A, cn: { <counted>_per_<around> }, share }], long_minus_short_A, long_minus_short_se_A }), declares it in its dataShape, names it in its description, and its joined-shell note quotes the parts, long - short with its sampling error and the shares by path in place of the peaks' separation ('3.98 F per Cu at 1.929 A + 2.01 at 2.251 A (first_shell.split.parts), 6 together, ... Long - short 0.321 +- 0.0043 A (first_shell.split: long_minus_short_A +- long_minus_short_se_A, the configuration's sampling error); 66 % / 34 % of the shell's count'). Arm A+ takes a Jahn-Teller claim's magnitude from the catalogue's split where it joins the claimed shell, else the separation of the maxima arm A reads (the app gives no split there), and records the split as a find_gr_peaks reading; arm A is unchanged. The context's pair_correlations does not carry the split. PROTOCOL_VERSION 2026-10-19.15 (other PRs hold .13 and .14; the lead renumbers at merge). Commits f608766 (shells), 29c585f (find_gr_peaks), e9e67e1 (arm A+, protocol) and c04ee50 (the re-recorded A+ record). Approved by the manager on the user's delegation, 2026-10-19.
